visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair and a white t-shirt sits in a gaming chair, speaking directly to the camera with a cheerful expression. The background is a brightly lit indoor workspace with a computer monitor visible. (2) The camera transitions to close-up shots of a black and yellow gaming chair. The leather surface of the seat is severely worn and cracked, with large sections of foam padding exposed through the tears. (3) A man with glasses wearing a black t-shirt lies on a grey fabric couch, holding a baby wrapped in a floral blanket. He looks towards the camera while talking. (4) The man stands at a doorway holding a large, heavy cardboard box with 'COUGAR SPEEDER ONE' printed on it. He carries it into the room, showing a look of surprise and curiosity. (5) A montage follows showing the man assembling a white and grey chair on a wooden floor. His hands are seen tightening screws and connecting various white plastic and mesh components. (6) The completed white ergonomic chair is showcased with smooth camera pans. Close-ups highlight the COUGAR logo on the headrest and the man's hands demonstrating the 2D folding armrests and seat depth adjustment levers. (7) The man sits in the new chair, laughing and gesturing comfortably. A young girl with short black hair and bangs appears at the bottom of the frame at the end, smiling widely and interacting with the camera.

(2) As the visuals shift to the broken chair, the BGM continues while the female narrator's tone becomes more descriptive and slightly exaggerated. (3) The audio switches to a dialogue between a man and a woman in a casual, domestic acoustic environment; the man's voice is calm and slightly confused, followed by a 'click' sound as a door opens. (4) A heavy 'thud' and the sound of cardboard rubbing against a floor occur as the man carries a large box, accompanied by his surprised vocal reaction. (5) A rhythmic montage begins with the sound of mechanical metallic clicks, rustling of plastic, and the 'whoosh' of transition sound effects, all synchronized with the upbeat BGM. (6) The man's voice returns, now sounding enthusiastic and explanatory as he details product features, with occasional 'ding' sound effects for emphasis. (7) The video concludes with the sounds of genuine laughter from both the man and the woman, and a child's high-pitched voice chirping a joyful 'Thank you, wife' before the audio fades out.
